title: The Episode About Banda Singh's Capture

blocks.text: Banda finally instructs the Sikhs to surrender arms and bodies rather than prolong a futile resistance, and the gates are opened in obedience to his command.
The Mughal side rejoices at this moment, taking it as the signal that Banda can now be seized without delay.
The page is therefore about surrender arms not as collapse of faith, but as the start of captivity.
